title: Windows Server 2022 reaches end of mainstream support in 60 days
summary: The company announced Windows Server 2022 in March 2021, and it became generally available in September 2021 as the Long-Term Servicing Channel (LTSC) release, with 10 years of support. "On October 13, 2026, Windows Server 2022 will reach end of mainstream support.
